name: § 1, point ay – 70
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: ay) increase public diplomacy efforts in China to provide authentic information about the EU’s policies and actions, and work to strengthen knowledge of China in all EU institutions; emphasise, while exchanges between European and Chinese universities are in place, the importance of clear guidance for engagement between EU universities and Chinese entities; underline that relations with China must respect the competences, national interests and sovereign foreign policy choices of the Member States; stress that coordination at EU level should complement, rather than replace, bilateral diplomacy conducted by Member States; reject attempts to impose a uniform foreign policy approach, given that Member States have differing legitimate economic, diplomatic and strategic interests;
